summary: Fix fidelity defects in ops_006 test harness and related test suites: forward caller auth tokens unchanged without fabricating tenant tokens, mount control loops router to sign two-man evidence via /bff/v5/interventions/{id}/two-man-sign keeping EmergencyContainment requires_two_man=True, remove warm-up request in read budget test, clean up dead routes/methods/fixtures/imports in b5 humangate test, and record deciding commits for retired commands.

acceptance_verification.ac1_caller_auth_forwarding: passed: ops_006 harness forwards caller auth token unchanged; stub fallback removed; tests authenticate with tenant-bearing tokens (Bearer op-mgmt-ops-006:operator:tenant-default)
acceptance_verification.ac2_two_man_control_preserved: passed: EmergencyContainment requires_two_man=True asserted without patching; real two-man evidence signed via /bff/v5/interventions/{id}/two-man-sign mounted via create_control_loops_router
acceptance_verification.ac3_read_budget_no_warmup: passed: removed GET /bff/management/data-sources/catalog warm-up request; timed request consistently stays within budget (<0.25s)
acceptance_verification.ac4_b5_dead_code_cleanup: passed: removed dead stub routes _human_inbox and _quarterly_ranking_recommendations, dead MockReadStore.get_ranking_snapshot, dead b5-human-001 fixture, and unused imports without modifying any assertions
acceptance_verification.ac5_deciding_commits_named: passed: Observe retirement commit ade4fd088 and RequestReview retirement commit 4b25b31f0 identified via git log -S and cited
acceptance_verification.ac6_all_tests_pass_no_regression: passed: 107 tests pass across all scoped and related BFF test suites with 0 failures
acceptance_verification.ac7_triage_classification: passed: every changed expectation classified as retired sample, intended change, or harness fidelity correction with deciding commit citations; no assertions weakened
acceptance_verification.ac8_no_compressed_code: passed: clean standard code formatting used; production line delta exactly 0

observe_command_retirement.detail: CommandType.OBSERVE was retired from CommandType and action catalog in ade4fd088 when persona lifecycle authority was forwarded to canonical lifecycle routes.

request_review_command_retirement.detail: CommandType.REQUEST_REVIEW was retired in 4b25b31f0 alongside 15 residual commands replaced by canonical governance approval decisions.

ops_006_harness_auth_and_two_man_fidelit.detail: Production command_adapters/service.py forwards popped auth token unchanged. Removed synthetic stub token substitution in test executor. Mounted create_control_loops_router and used real two-man evidence via /bff/v5/interventions/{id}/two-man-sign with two distinct operators, preserving requires_two_man=True.

management_read_budget_warmup_removal.detail: Removed pre-warming GET /bff/management/data-sources/catalog call before timed degradation request; degradation assertion passes without warm-up.

b5_humangate_dead_code_removal.detail: Removed dead stub routes (_human_inbox, _quarterly_ranking_recommendations), dead MockReadStore.get_ranking_snapshot, b5-human-001 fixture, and unused imports left after #6255.
